S Squared — wordmark & monogram (2020).

When the name is already a visual pun, the job is to honour it without leaning on a cheap exponent. So the identity says it three ways at once: the mathematical S², two S-forms mirrored into a single interlocked monogram, and the plain wordmark squared off inside a frame.

It all rests on one fine, high-contrast didone S — which keeps even the most playful route reading as a considered, premium mark rather than a maths joke.

Brand identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·75.
